description: Test observable behavior, not implementation details. Verify public API and visible state changes. Don't assert on private methods or internal flags. Example: assert agent.config_path.exists() (observable); not assert agent._internal_flag (private)

do.description: Test observable outcomes through public API. Example: assert agent.config_path == expected; assert agent.is_initialized (public properties)

guidance.description: Assert on public properties and return values
Assert on observable file system state

example: # Test: 'config is loaded' not 'json.loads was called'

dont.description: Don't test private state or implementation details. Example: assert agent._initialized (wrong); assert agent._config_cache (wrong)

example: assert agent._config_cache is not None  # WRONG - implementation detail

guidance.description: Don't assert on internal method calls
Don't test HOW something is done
example: # WRONG: Testing that specific method was called
assert mock_parser.parse.called  # Test the RESULT instead
